systemFinding.title: Implicit third-party tool-output budget cuts needed instructions
systemFinding.bgsSource: packages/agent-workflow-server/src/bgs/runner.ts:136 bgsProviderConfig does not set tool_output_token_limit or third-party model metadata
systemFinding.nativeReferenceReadOnly: vendor/bgs/bgs-rs/models-manager/src/model_info.rs: fallback truncation_policy bytes(10000); with_config_overrides supports tool_output_token_limit
systemFinding.nativeCap: vendor/bgs/bgs-rs/core/src/tools/context.rs:481 model_output_policy takes min(requested,model policy); exec max_output_tokens alone cannot exceed the model cap
systemFinding.causalLimit: Proves missing instructions, not that all document mistakes or costs were caused by this omission. The model saw an explicit truncation warning but did not recover it.
systemFinding.minimalProposal: Use existing native tool_output_token_limit through BGS configuration; evaluate bounded 10000 estimated tokens (~40000 bytes), sufficient for these four observed outputs. No Codex patch, unlimited output, reread enforcement or added stage. Explicit overrides/normal provider behavior must be considered. Test native mocked transport offline before claiming effective fix.
systemFinding.validation: All four raw outputs exceed 10000 bytes but fit 40000; review headings exist in original Skill but not model-facing truncated result. Budget change itself has not been implemented or runtime-tested.
